subject: MedBase POC: success criteria, final readout scheduling, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@medbase.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: MedBase POC: recap + proposed success criteria and next steps

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we spin up the POC environment: 

Summary from our discovery call:
- Goal: validate that Redwood inference reduces per-token cost while maintaining latency SLOs for MedBase’s clinical summarization pipeline.
- Workload: 50k clinical notes/day, avg seq length ~1,200 tokens; latency SLO = 300ms p95 for single-note inference.
- Stakeholders: Samira (PM, MedBase), Liam (CTO), Procurement for contract.

Proposed success criteria (attached spreadsheet has details):
1) Accuracy: output ROUGE-L >= 0.72 vs your current baseline on the dev prompt set (we’ll use the 200-note sample you shared).
2) Latency: p95 latency <= 300ms on Dedicated config (NVIDIA A10x) for single-note calls.
3) Cost: tokenized unit cost <= your current baseline by >= 25% for the target throughput when batching enabled.
4) Stability: zero service-impacting errors during the 2-week trial window.

Next steps / timeline proposal:
- This week (Feb 16–18): exchange final sample data + access instructions (we can take anonymized samples).
- Feb 22: Redwood to deliver POC environment + SOW draft.
- Feb 23–Mar 6: 2-week POC (data load, tuning, live runs).
- Mar 8: Final readout with execs + go/no-go decision.

Owners:
- Redwood: Marcus will own setup and tuning; I’ll coordinate SOW/contract.
- MedBase: Samira to own sample data and evaluation sign-off; Liam for exec readout.

I attached a one-sheet with the success criteria and a draft SOW for review. Please respond with any edits to the criteria or alternative dates for the final readout.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Mid-Market Sales
Redwood Inference

--Attachment: MedBase_POC_success_criteria.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 48KB)
--Attachment: Redwood_SOW_draft.pdf (application/pdf, 72KB)

Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MedBase POC: recap + proposed success criteria and next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is great and aligns with what we discussed. A couple quick notes: 

- The 200-note sample is ready; I’ll drop a sanitized CSV to the secure link you provided by EOD Tue (Feb 17).
- One clarification on latency: the p95 <=300ms is what we need for single-note request patterns; if batching is used for bulk processing that’s fine, but the single-note SLA is highest priority.
- For accuracy we’d prefer to see ROUGE-L >=0.75 if achievable; our baseline is slightly higher than we initially called out.

We can tentatively confirm the Feb 23–Mar 6 window for the POC. For the final readout, Liam prefers Mar 9 at 10am PT for the exec slot — does that work for you and Marcus?

Samira
Senior PM, Data Platform
MedBase
